title: iris × borzae
intro: Iris × borzae, commonly known as the hybrid orris, is a fragrant, flowering plant that belongs to the iris family (Iridaceae). The health benefits of Iris × borzae include its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues due to its calming and soothing effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as a sedative, antispasmodic, and carminative, which can help to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and digestive discomfort. The bioactive constituents of Iris × borzae include iridoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and fragrance.
